decisions: Three sensor scenes proved byte-identical and consolidated in models/.
Distinct Approved_v3.blend retained as required film builder input.
Open Sans fonts and notices consolidated; each pipeline stages shared inputs at runtime.
Accepted MP4 outputs preserved byte-for-byte; film MP4 was delivered separately from original source ZIP.
GLB revised to clean-measurement state with 51 hardware meshes, two paths and 15 particles.
Generated frame caches, logs, old archive manifests, backup scenes and experimental outputs excluded.
Original GIF outputs included for the public project repository; website uses MP4 equivalents.
Visual algorithms unchanged apart from portable path handling, subset smoke options and missing-frame guards.
Regenerable film metadata, visibility masks and layout caches omitted; accepted packed scene and complete generating algorithms retained.
Existing compact tour contact sheet used as gallery; duplicate large preview PNG omitted.
Blender files losslessly repacked with Zstandard level 19; exact decoded-byte identity recorded separately.

Publication audit removed embedded build-machine paths from three Blender scenes using fixed-size null-padded relative paths; all other decompressed bytes retained. Current hashes recorded in blend-compression.json.
